tips.text: Farm eggs by speed-running Earth Capture on Mantle: break every Kubrow Den, grab the target, extract, repeat.
Break dens with wide AoE, such as a max-range Xaku casting The Vast Untime twice per room, and head for the den-kill affinity popups to find the egg.
Ask clanmates or Kubrow breeders for two Huras imprints instead of rolling; they often hand spares out free.
Build the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment early if you expect several rolls; it halves each incubation.
Build the Power Core just before you incubate, since every roll consumes one.
Take an unwanted Kubrow's two imprints before consigning it to the Lotus; they trade or sell.
Expect long runs of the same wrong breed; the five breeds really are equal odds.
Egg drops are streaky: one player needed about 20 dens, another about 200 for two eggs.
Nobody complains about the farm itself; every complaint is about RNG streaks.
